name: Skin Lesion Tree Ensemble Benchmark
description: Evaluates and compares the performance of tree-based ensemble methods (random forest, gradient boosting) on skin lesion image classification tasks.
evaluation_method: AUC (ROC) and accuracy; F1 is also commonly reported for class-imbalanced settings
typical_sota_score: AUC ~0.75–0.90 for tree-ensemble approaches (deep models on similar tasks may score higher)
reputation: A targeted benchmark for assessing classical tree-ensemble methods on skin lesion classification; less commonly used than deep-learning benchmarks but useful for tabular/feature-based baselines.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; performance sensitive to feature extraction / preprocessing; potential dataset size/label-quality limitations and privacy constraints common in medical imaging; results must be validated externally for clinical relevance.
